test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the following number arrangement and answer the question given below. All numbers given below are 2 digit numbers.

13 56 46 23 16 34 25 19 78 85 86 24 29 73 94 52 64 63

What will be the difference between the sum of the first half and second half of the above series?
solution:
Given numbers: 13 56 46 23 16 34 25 19 78 85 86 24 29 73 94 52 64 63

Now,

The first half is: 13 56 46 23 16 34 25 19 78

The sum of the first half is: 310.

The second half is: 85 86 24 29 73 94 52 64 63

The sum of the first half is: 570.

So, the difference between the sum of the first half and second half is: 310 - 570 = -**260**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
